input_classes_examined: C1: n=0 identity — loop body never runs; output must equal the input date
C2: within-month spans — start day + n stays inside the start month, no month-length comparison is exceeded
C3: single month-boundary rollover for each month Jan..Dec — last day of month + 1 must be the 1st of the next month, and (last day - 1) + 1 must NOT roll over; exercises every DAYS table entry
C5: year rollover — 2023/2024/2025-12-31 + 1 -> Jan 1 of the following year
C6: multi-month spans with n up to 60 crossing up to two month boundaries — checks accumulation of month lengths

C7: spans passing through a day the DAYS table denies exists — August 31 is real but the table lists August as 30 days, so every span whose true result is Aug 31 or passes through it is shifted one day late
